title: [QM] Move Inventory: allow destination location for non-directed item
summary: The Move Inventory report in Quality Management now allows users to specify a destination location when moving non-directed items, removing a previous restriction that prevented this operation.
key_points: Users can now set a destination location for non-directed items in the Move Inventory process
The previous limitation that blocked destination location selection for certain item types is removed
New test cases validate the destination location functionality for non-directed items
The change maintains backward compatibility while expanding functionality
